query:
-- 查询 jiang 用户的 ID
SELECT id, username, name FROM users WHERE username = 'jiang';

-- 查询 jiang 作为分享者的记录
SELECT 
  csc.id,
  csc.sharerId,
  sharer.username as sharerUsername,
  csc.receiverId,
  receiver.username as receiverUsername,
  csc.status,
  csc.createdAt
FROM contact_sharing_connections csc
LEFT JOIN users sharer ON csc.sharerId = sharer.id
LEFT JOIN users receiver ON csc.receiverId = receiver.id
WHERE csc.sharerId = 29;

-- 查询 jiang 作为接收者的记录
SELECT 
  csc.id,
  csc.sharerId,
  sharer.username as sharerUsername,
  csc.receiverId,
  receiver.username as receiverUsername,
  csc.status,
  csc.createdAt
FROM contact_sharing_connections csc
LEFT JOIN users sharer ON csc.sharerId = sharer.id
LEFT JOIN users receiver ON csc.receiverId = receiver.id
WHERE csc.receiverId = 29;
